name: @ntasks/api
description: The Ntasks Worker: the HTTP API over one D1 database, and the host of the web app.

scripts.typecheck: node scripts/api-versions.ts && wrangler types --check && tsc && tsc -p test && tsc -p test/node && tsc -p scripts
scripts.test: vitest run && node --test test/node/routing.ts test/node/migrations.ts test/node/provision.ts test/node/api-versions.ts
scripts.deploy: node scripts/api-versions.ts && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote < /dev/null && wrangler deploy
